segments.title: Paid inbox or free one?
segments.say: Superhuman or Inbox Zero: a paid AI inbox, or a free one?

segments.title: Not tested by us
segments.say: Not tested by us. This is based on official info.

segments.title: Superhuman
segments.say: Superhuman lists only paid plans. AI is on every plan. Auto Drafts start on Business.

segments.title: Inbox Zero
segments.say: Inbox Zero's email app is free. Pay for the AI, or host the open source code yourself.

segments.title: Both draft your replies
segments.say: Both can draft replies for you to check before you send.
